mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO prep_item(session_id, ingredient_id, plan_amount_g, status, is_shortage, note, remark) VALUES
(#{item.sessionId}, #{item.ingredientId}, #{item.planAmountG}, #{item.status}, #{item.isShortage}, NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT pi.ingredient_id AS ingredientId, i.name AS ingredientName, i.unit AS unit, pi.plan_amount_g AS planAmountG, pi.status AS status, pi.is_shortage AS isShortage FROM prep_item pi INNER JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = pi.ingredient_id WHERE pi.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY pi.ingredient_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_review(session_id, dish_id, taste_score, difficulty_score, retry_intent, review_note, remark) VALUES (#{sessionId}, NULL, #{tasteScore}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)

INSERT INTO session_dish(session_id, dish_id, sort_order, remark) VALUES
(#{r.sessionId}, #{r.dishId}, #{r.sortOrder}, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id AS reviewId, session_id AS sessionId, dish_id AS dishId, taste_score AS tasteScore, difficulty_score AS difficultyScore, retry_intent AS retryIntent, review_note AS reviewNote, created_at AS createdAt FROM session_review WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id DESC
